column1: # B071 probe corpus - enum conversion and enum-member verdicts from the LIVE game.
# Trackmania + Openplanet 1.29.5, RemoteBuild 127.0.0.1:30000, 2026-08-31.
# See README.md for the ACCEPT-vs-REJECT asymmetry before using any row.
# METHOD. Every row was compiled as its OWN plugin (one fixture, one unit).
#   Never batched: B068 showed that one parse error in a batched unit makes
#   every other name in that unit read as ACCEPTED. A batched run of this
#   corpus would have reported rows 3-7 as clean.
# CONTROLS, run in the same session as the samples:
#   r0  enum LocalOne{X}; LocalOne a = LocalOne::X;   -> CLEAN  (oracle accepts)
#   rX  ZZZNoSuchType q;                              -> ERR    (oracle rejects)
#   Both behaved. An oracle that cannot fail proves nothing about the rows.
# CONFOUND FOUND AND CLEARED. The first pass used
# `EDummyCollectionIdent::Undefined`, which DOES NOT EXIST in the live game;
# rows 1, 3 and 6 carried a stray "No matching symbol" as a result. That is
# harmless for a REJECT row (an error appeared, and an error is
# self-evidencing) and FATAL for row 4, whose conclusion is drawn from the
# ABSENCE of an error. Row 4 was therefore re-measured three ways, including
# an anti-vacuity guard (r2s) proving the fixture reaches the typechecker at
# all, and with VirtualKey::A - a value already recorded as a live ACCEPT in
# b053-bare-enum-values.tsv, rather than a guessed one.
# lsp_today: what openplanet-lsp reports on the same bytes as of master 46ac5d5.
